findings.defect: The English makes the silver blood itself acidic. The Korean says that even this intense acidity can no longer harm him; it does not identify the blood as the source of the acidity.
findings.rationale: The Korean phrase is “이토록 지독한 산성조차도” (“even acidity this intense”), not “this acidic blood.”
findings.replacement: even acidity this intense could no longer harm a single hair on his head

summary: The chapter is largely faithful. One line attributes the acidity to the blood rather than to the surrounding acidic substance.
